proof:
intro X _ S δ hδ
constructor
· intro h
  have hf : Metric.ediam S ≠ ⊤ := ne_top_of_le_ne_top ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top h

  have he : ENNReal.ofReal (Metric.diam S) = Metric.ediam S := ENNReal.ofReal_toReal hb.ediam_ne_top
  rw [← he]
  exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hd
